observation.command: mkdir -p /sys/fs/cgroup/probe 2>&1; echo "mkdir rc=$?"; ls /sys/fs/cgroup/probe/ 2>&1; echo ---; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/probe/cgroup.type 2>&1; echo ---; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/probe/cgroup.controllers 2>&1; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/probe/cgroup.subtree_control 2>&1; echo ---; echo $$ > /sys/fs/cgroup/probe/cgroup.procs 2>&1; echo "join rc=$?"
